description: This PHP script handles sending emails to contacts, leads, and accounts within the vtiger CRM system based on a custom view. It retrieves email addresses, composes emails, and sends them via SMTP, then redirects to a specific view.

classes.name: PHPMailer
classes.description: A class for composing and sending emails via SMTP, included from modules/Emails/class.phpmailer.php

methods.name: SendMailtoCustomView
methods.description: Function to send an email to a specified address with given subject and content, using SMTP server details from the database.
